sources.title: Consulate General of Burkina Faso in Paris: ordinary-passport visa applications
sources.publisher: Consulate General of Burkina Faso in Paris
sources.officialityEvidence: The current consulate page is on the Burkina Faso diplomatic-government domain and directly links the Visa Burkina service for ordinary-passport applications; its operation was rechecked but the page was intermittently unavailable from this environment.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Les demandes de visas pour les passeports ordinaires peuvent être ... soumis ... en ligne sur le site internet https://www.visaburkina.bf/.

sources.title: Visa Burkina: current eVisa FAQ and online workflow
sources.publisher: Ministry of Security / Directorate General of the National Police
sources.officialityEvidence: The exact portal is directly linked by the Paris Consulate official page; its current footer identifies the Ministry of Security and Directorate General of the National Police. The FAQ defines the eVisa as replacing the conventional passport sticker and says it is emailed after ministerial approval.
sources.supportingExcerpt: le visa électronique est envoyé, après approbation ministérielle, par e-mail au requérant

sources.title: Visa Burkina: current entry conditions
sources.publisher: Ministry of Security / Directorate General of the National Police
sources.officialityEvidence: This current Ministry of Security/National Police portal page is part of the externally authenticated Visa Burkina service.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Un visa d’entrée ou un accord de visa ou un permis ou titre de séjour sauf exemption
